blocks.en: Compare the specification differences between non-pharmacopeial water grades (ISO, ASTM, CLSI/CLRW) and pharmacopeial waters (PW, WFI)

blocks.en: Identify appropriate sampling point locations for different water distribution system geometries

blocks.zh: 理解影響純蒸汽發生器（PSG）效能的因素及監控要求
blocks.en: Understand the factors affecting pure steam generator (PSG) performance and the monitoring requirements

blocks.zh: 利用參考文獻清單查找原始法規與藥典文件
blocks.en: Use the reference list to locate the original regulatory and pharmacopeial documents

blocks.zh: 將術語表定義應用於正確解讀 ISPE 取樣指南術語
blocks.en: Apply the glossary definitions to interpret the terminology of the ISPE Sampling Guide correctly

blocks.zh: 中文說明與實務應用
blocks.en: Commentary and Practical Application

blocks.zh: 何時使用附錄一？
blocks.en: When to Use Appendix 1

blocks.zh: 當 QC 實驗室或製程工程師需要選擇「非藥典級」試劑水時使用——例如 HPLC 流動相、溶液製備或生物分析支援用水。這些水不是 PW 或 WFI，但仍有嚴格規格。
blocks.en: Use it when a QC laboratory or process engineer needs to select a "non-pharmacopeial" reagent water, for example for HPLC mobile phase, solution preparation or water supporting bioanalysis. These waters are not PW or WFI, but they still have strict specifications.

blocks.zh: 各標準定位一覽
blocks.en: Overview of Where Each Standard Fits

blocks.zh: ISO 3696：歐洲/國際實驗室標準，以 UV 吸光度控制有機物，適合光學分析
blocks.en: ISO 3696: a European/international laboratory standard that controls organics by UV absorbance, suited to optical analysis

blocks.zh: ASTM D1193 Type I：最高純度試劑水，電阻率 18 MΩ·cm，對應 CLRW，用於精密分析
blocks.en: ASTM D1193 Type I: the highest-purity reagent water, resistivity 18 MΩ·cm, equivalent to CLRW, used for precision analysis

blocks.zh: ASTM Type II：一般實驗室用水，電阻率 1 MΩ·cm，適合常規 QC 分析
blocks.en: ASTM Type II: general laboratory water, resistivity 1 MΩ·cm, suitable for routine QC analysis

blocks.zh: CLRW：臨床實驗室試劑水，CLSI 定義，18.2±1 MΩ·cm，內毒素 <0.03 EU/mL（Grade A）
blocks.en: CLRW: clinical laboratory reagent water as defined by CLSI, 18.2±1 MΩ·cm, endotoxin <0.03 EU/mL (Grade A)

blocks.zh: CDMO QA/QC 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points for CDMO QA/QC

blocks.zh: TOC 比較：ASTM Type I 要求 ≤50 ppb TOC——與藥典 PW/WFI 的 0.5 mg/L（500 ppb）相比更嚴格，適合高靈敏度分析
blocks.en: TOC comparison: ASTM Type I requires ≤50 ppb TOC, which is stricter than the 0.5 mg/L (500 ppb) of pharmacopeial PW/WFI and suits high-sensitivity analysis

blocks.zh: 電導度：ASTM Type I 電導度 0.0555 µS/cm，遠比藥典 PW（約 1.3 µS/cm）嚴格，若實驗室用藥典 PW 替代 Type I 可能導致分析偏差
blocks.en: Conductivity: ASTM Type I conductivity is 0.0555 µS/cm, far stricter than pharmacopeial PW (about 1.3 µS/cm); if a laboratory substitutes pharmacopeial PW for Type I, analytical bias may result

blocks.zh: 微生物：CLSI 設有 Grade A/B/C 三階級，ASTM 本身未設細菌限度——臨床實驗室水需特別參考 CLSI
blocks.en: Microbiology: CLSI defines three grades (A/B/C), while ASTM itself sets no bacterial limit; clinical laboratory water requires specific reference to CLSI

blocks.zh: 內毒素：CLSI Grade A 的 0.03 EU/mL 接近 WFI 的 0.25 EU/mL，適用於細胞培養或生物檢定支援水
blocks.en: Endotoxin: the CLSI Grade A limit of 0.03 EU/mL is close to the WFI limit of 0.25 EU/mL, and is suitable for water supporting cell culture or bioassays

blocks.zh: 實驗室選水決策樹（簡化）
blocks.en: Laboratory Water Selection Decision Tree (Simplified)

blocks.zh: HPLC/UHPLC 流動相 → ASTM Type I 或 ISO Grade 1（超純水）
blocks.en: HPLC/UHPLC mobile phase → ASTM Type I or ISO Grade 1 (ultrapure water)

blocks.zh: 一般緩衝液、溶劑製備 → ASTM Type II 或 ISO Grade 2
blocks.en: General buffer and solvent preparation → ASTM Type II or ISO Grade 2

blocks.zh: 玻璃器皿清洗最終淋洗 → ASTM Type III 或 ISO Grade 3
blocks.en: Final rinse for glassware washing → ASTM Type III or ISO Grade 3

blocks.zh: 細胞培養、生物檢定 → CLRW（Grade A），加內毒素管控
blocks.en: Cell culture, bioassays → CLRW (Grade A), with endotoxin control added

blocks.zh: WFI 製程用水 → 藥典規格（另見本指南第 2 章）
blocks.en: WFI process water → pharmacopeial specification (see also Chapter 2 of this guide)

blocks.zh: 與藥典水的關係
blocks.en: Relationship to Pharmacopeial Water

blocks.zh: 藥典 PW（USP <1231>）的 TOC ≤0.5 mg/L（500 ppb）、電導度依 Stage 1/2/3 表格，比 ASTM Type I 寬鬆——這意味著 PW 不能直接替代高精度分析所需的 Type I 試劑水。在 CDMO 實驗室，應視用途分別採購或另建超純水系統。
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial PW (USP <1231>) has a TOC of ≤0.5 mg/L (500 ppb) and conductivity per the Stage 1/2/3 tables, which are less strict than ASTM Type I. This means PW cannot directly replace the Type I reagent water needed for high-precision analysis. In a CDMO laboratory, source each separately according to the intended use, or set up a separate ultrapure water system.

blocks.en: USP <1231>: the full picture of pharmacopeial waters, including newer grades such as HPWFI

blocks.zh: 何時使用附錄二？
blocks.en: When to Use Appendix 2

blocks.zh: 設計或審查 PW/WFI 配水系統取樣計畫時使用。當 QA 工程師或驗證人員需要決定「在哪裡放取樣閥？」以及「哪個配置適用於我的系統？」時，這些圖示提供了直觀的參考框架。
blocks.en: Use it when designing or reviewing the sampling plan for a PW/WFI distribution system. When a QA engineer or validation specialist needs to decide "where should the sample valves go?" and "which configuration applies to my system?", these diagrams provide an intuitive reference framework.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見問題
blocks.en: Common CDMO Issues

blocks.zh: 軟管管理：軟管是最常被驗證審查員指出的缺失——需有「軟管控制 SOP」，規定連接前沖洗時間、儲存方式（懸掛乾燥）、使用前確認
blocks.en: Hose management: hoses are the deficiency most often cited by validation reviewers; a "hose control SOP" is needed, specifying flushing time before connection, storage method (hung to dry) and checks before use

blocks.zh: 熱交換器冷卻後取樣：很多工廠只在熱回路取樣，忽略 HX 出口冷水。若 HX 冷卻至 <65°C，必須增設取樣點並提高頻率
blocks.en: Sampling after heat exchanger cooling: many plants sample only in the hot loop and ignore the cold water at the HX outlet. If the HX cools the water to <65°C, a sampling point must be added and the frequency increased

blocks.zh: 子回路：CDMO 多廠區或多用途工廠常見子回路設計，需注意子回路的獨立 IQ/OQ/PQ 記錄及獨立取樣計畫
blocks.en: Sub-loops: sub-loop designs are common in multi-site or multi-purpose CDMO plants; note the need for independent IQ/OQ/PQ records and an independent sampling plan for each sub-loop

blocks.zh: 系統邊界（System Boundary）的意義
blocks.en: Meaning of the System Boundary

blocks.zh: 系統邊界決定了「驗證範圍」——邊界內的管件、閥門、取樣點均需在 URS/FS 中定義，並納入 IQ/OQ/PQ 測試計畫。邊界外的設備（如製程設備本身）另行處理。取樣點通常設在邊界線的水系統側，確保樣品代表受控水系統的水質。
blocks.en: The system boundary determines the "validation scope": the piping, valves and sampling points within the boundary must all be defined in the URS/FS and included in the IQ/OQ/PQ test plans. Equipment outside the boundary (such as the process equipment itself) is handled separately. Sampling points are usually located on the water system side of the boundary line, to ensure the sample represents the quality of the controlled water system.

blocks.zh: P&ID 文件要求
blocks.en: P&ID Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 每個取樣點（含取樣閥閥號）必須標示在最新版 P&ID 上，並與取樣計畫 SOP 中的取樣點 ID 對應。審查員常會對照 P&ID 與取樣 SOP——確保兩者一致是 CDMO QA 的基本作業要求。
blocks.en: Every sampling point (including the sample valve number) must be shown on the current P&ID and correspond to the sampling point ID in the sampling plan SOP. Reviewers often cross-check the P&ID against the sampling SOP; ensuring the two are consistent is a basic operating requirement for CDMO QA.

blocks.zh: 何時使用附錄三？
blocks.en: When to Use Appendix 3

blocks.zh: 設計純蒸汽系統取樣計畫、調查純蒸汽品質異常（電導度偏高、內毒素超標）、或審核 PSG 前處理系統監控策略時使用。附錄三也是 CDMO 工廠在更換市政供水消毒方式時必須審查的參考文件。
blocks.en: Use it when designing a pure steam sampling plan, investigating pure steam quality anomalies (high conductivity, endotoxin excursions), or reviewing the monitoring strategy for the PSG pretreatment system. Appendix 3 is also a reference document that a CDMO plant must review when changing the disinfection method of the municipal water supply.

blocks.zh: 3-log 去除率的實際意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of 3-Log Removal

blocks.zh: 3-log = 99.9% 雜質去除。若 PW 進水內毒素為 10 EU/mL，純蒸汽冷凝水預期 ≤0.01 EU/mL（符合 USP 要求 <0.25 EU/mL）。但若 PW 進水內毒素高達 500 EU/mL，即使 3-log 去除，冷凝水仍可能達 0.5 EU/mL——超標！這說明 PW 系統的微生物控制對 PSG 性能至關重要。
blocks.en: 3-log = 99.9% removal of impurities. If the endotoxin in the PW feed is 10 EU/mL, the pure steam condensate is expected to be ≤0.01 EU/mL (meeting the USP requirement of <0.25 EU/mL). But if the endotoxin in the PW feed is as high as 500 EU/mL, even with 3-log removal the condensate may still reach 0.5 EU/mL, which is out of specification. This shows that microbial control of the PW system is critical to PSG performance.

blocks.zh: 氯胺（Chloramine）問題——CDMO 實際警示
blocks.en: The Chloramine Issue: A Practical Warning for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 台灣及許多地區已開始在自來水中使用氯胺替代氯消毒。若活性碳床前處理設計為去氯（不去氯胺），氨氮將穿透，導致純蒸汽電導度超標。
blocks.en: Taiwan and many other regions have begun using chloramine instead of chlorine to disinfect tap water. If the activated carbon bed pretreatment is designed for dechlorination (not chloramine removal), ammonia nitrogen will break through and cause pure steam conductivity to exceed limits.

blocks.zh: 確認當地市政水廠是否使用氯胺——向水廠索取水質報告
blocks.en: Confirm whether the local municipal water utility uses chloramine, and request the water quality report from the utility

blocks.zh: 確認活性碳床設計是否能有效去除氯胺（接觸時間 EBCT ≥10 分鐘通常有效）
blocks.en: Confirm that the activated carbon bed design can effectively remove chloramine (an empty bed contact time (EBCT) of ≥10 minutes is usually effective)

blocks.zh: 在活性碳床出口監測氨氮（NH₃-N）
blocks.en: Monitor ammonia nitrogen (NH₃-N) at the activated carbon bed outlet

blocks.zh: 任何市政供水消毒方式變更均應觸發 CAPA 評估
blocks.en: Any change in the disinfection method of the municipal water supply should trigger a CAPA assessment

blocks.zh: 不凝性氣體（NCG）與蒸汽滅菌
blocks.en: Non-Condensable Gases (NCG) and Steam Sterilization

blocks.zh: NCG 是蒸汽滅菌最常見的失效原因之一。NCG 會在滅菌腔室冷點堆積，阻礙蒸汽接觸——即使溫度計顯示達標，局部冷點溫度仍可能不足。
blocks.en: NCG is one of the most common causes of steam sterilization failure. NCG accumulates at cold spots in the sterilization chamber and prevents steam contact; even if the thermometer shows the target is met, the local cold spot temperature may still be insufficient.

blocks.zh: 熱 WFI 進水：溶解氣體少，NCG 問題低
blocks.en: Hot WFI feed: little dissolved gas, so NCG is a minor problem

blocks.zh: 常溫脫離子水進水：需安裝真空脫氣裝置
blocks.en: Ambient-temperature deionized water feed: a vacuum degassing unit must be installed

blocks.zh: 臭氧消毒系統：臭氧分解後產生氧氣，可能增加 NCG
blocks.en: Ozone sanitization systems: ozone decomposes to produce oxygen, which may increase NCG

blocks.zh: 定期以 Bowie-Dick 測試或 NCG 測試驗證蒸汽品質
blocks.en: Periodically verify steam quality with the Bowie-Dick test or an NCG test

blocks.zh: Blow Down 管理
blocks.en: Blow Down Management

blocks.zh: Blow Down（排污）是控制 PSG 中溶解固體（TDS）累積的關鍵操作。排污率過低：TDS 濃縮，電導度超標；排污率過高：能源浪費、進水量增加。建議：定期測試排污水的電導度和 TOC，按廠商建議設定排污率，並文件化。
blocks.en: Blow down is the key operation for controlling the accumulation of total dissolved solids (TDS) in the PSG. If the blow down rate is too low, TDS concentrates and conductivity exceeds limits; if it is too high, energy is wasted and feedwater consumption increases. Recommendation: periodically test the conductivity and TOC of the blow down water, set the blow down rate according to the manufacturer's recommendation, and document it.

blocks.zh: 縮寫表的實務用途
blocks.en: Practical Use of the Acronym Table

blocks.zh: 閱讀 ISPE 或 FDA 文件時遇到不熟悉的縮寫，第一查閱點。CDMO 新進工程師或 QA 人員在接受水系統培訓時，建議先通讀縮寫表以建立基礎語彙。
blocks.en: The first place to look when you meet an unfamiliar acronym in an ISPE or FDA document. New CDMO engineers or QA staff undergoing water system training are advised to read through the acronym table first to build a basic vocabulary.

blocks.zh: 容易混淆的縮寫對
blocks.en: Easily Confused Acronym Pairs

blocks.zh: PSG vs PSE：PSG = 純蒸汽發生器（設備）；PSE = 週期性系統評估（活動）
blocks.en: PSG vs PSE: PSG = pure steam generator (equipment); PSE = periodic system evaluation (activity)

blocks.zh: CEDI vs RO：CEDI = 連續電去離子（EDI 的連續版）；RO = 逆滲透（前處理）
blocks.en: CEDI vs RO: CEDI = continuous electrodeionization (the continuous version of EDI); RO = reverse osmosis (pretreatment)

blocks.zh: CQA vs CPP：CQA = 關鍵品質屬性（水/蒸汽品質指標）；CPP = 關鍵製程參數（影響品質的操作條件）
blocks.en: CQA vs CPP: CQA = critical quality attribute (water/steam quality indicator); CPP = critical process parameter (operating condition affecting quality)

blocks.zh: OOS vs Alert/Action Limit：OOS = 超出規格（需調查）；超 Alert Limit = 警示（需監控）；超 Action Limit = 需採取措施（不一定 OOS）
blocks.en: OOS vs Alert/Action Limit: OOS = out of specification (requires investigation); exceeding the Alert Limit = warning (requires monitoring); exceeding the Action Limit = action required (not necessarily OOS)

blocks.zh: How to Use This Glossary | 如何使用術語表
blocks.en: How to Use This Glossary

blocks.zh: 雙語術語表提供 ISPE 官方定義（英文）、繁體中文說明，以及 CDMO QA/QC 團隊的實務應用指引。依原文字母順序排列。
blocks.en: The bilingual glossary provides the official ISPE definitions (in English), commentary, and practical application guidance for CDMO QA/QC teams. Entries are arranged in alphabetical order of the original text.

blocks.zh: 中文完整指南摘要
blocks.en: Commentary: Complete Guide Summary

blocks.zh: 本指南在 CDMO 的核心價值
blocks.en: Core Value of This Guide for CDMOs

blocks.zh: ISPE 取樣指南（2016）是唯一針對製藥水、蒸汽和製程氣體取樣作業的完整實踐指南。對 CDMO 而言，這份指南是以下工作的基礎：
blocks.en: The ISPE Sampling Guide (2016) is the only complete practice guide dedicated to sampling operations for pharmaceutical water, steam and process gases. For a CDMO, this guide is the foundation for:

blocks.zh: 建立或更新水系統取樣計畫 SOP
blocks.en: Establishing or updating the water system sampling plan SOP

blocks.zh: 應對 FDA/EMA 稽核員關於取樣合理性的問題
blocks.en: Responding to FDA/EMA auditor questions about the rationale for sampling

blocks.zh: 設計新廠或改造既有水系統時的取樣點規劃
blocks.en: Planning sampling points when designing a new plant or retrofitting an existing water system

blocks.zh: 實施風險評估以優化取樣頻率（降低成本同時維持品質保證）
blocks.en: Performing risk assessments to optimize sampling frequency (reducing cost while maintaining quality assurance)

blocks.zh: 指南的三個核心哲學
blocks.en: The Guide's Three Core Philosophies

blocks.zh: 代表性（Representativeness）：每個樣品必須真正代表被監測系統的實際狀態——沖洗程序、取樣點位置、和取樣時機都影響代表性
blocks.en: Representativeness: every sample must truly represent the actual state of the system being monitored; the flushing procedure, sampling point location and sampling timing all affect representativeness

blocks.zh: 風險導向（Risk-Based）：取樣頻率和取樣點數量應由風險評估決定，而不是「越多越好」——過度取樣浪費資源，但欠缺取樣則形成法規風險
blocks.en: Risk-Based: sampling frequency and the number of sampling points should be determined by risk assessment, not by "the more the better"; over-sampling wastes resources, but under-sampling creates regulatory risk

blocks.zh: 持續改善（Continuous Improvement）：通過趨勢分析（SPC）、定期系統評估（PSE）和 CAPA 機制，讓取樣計畫隨系統成熟而優化
blocks.en: Continuous Improvement: through trend analysis (SPC), periodic system evaluation (PSE) and the CAPA mechanism, the sampling plan is optimized as the system matures

blocks.zh: 指南更新與後續發展
blocks.en: Guide Updates and Subsequent Developments

blocks.zh: 本指南出版於 2016 年。自出版以來的重要變化：
blocks.en: This guide was published in 2016. Important changes since publication:

blocks.zh: EP 2017 年允許非蒸餾法製備 WFI（影響 WFI 系統設計和監控策略）
blocks.en: In 2017 the EP allowed WFI to be produced by non-distillation methods (affecting WFI system design and monitoring strategy)

blocks.zh: EudraLex Annex 1 2022 年大幅修訂（引入 CCS 概念，影響無菌工廠水系統要求）
blocks.en: EudraLex Annex 1 was substantially revised in 2022 (introducing the CCS concept, affecting water system requirements in sterile plants)

blocks.zh: USP <1231> 持續更新（HPWFI 等新等級，取樣和測試方法更新）
blocks.en: USP <1231> continues to be updated (new grades such as HPWFI, and updated sampling and test methods)

blocks.zh: RMM（快速微生物方法）技術進步（ATP 螢光、流式細胞儀）改變微生物監控模式
blocks.en: Advances in RMM (rapid microbiological methods) technology (ATP fluorescence, flow cytometry) are changing microbial monitoring models

blocks.zh: PAT 和 Industry 4.0 推動更多連續監控和實時放行（RTR）應用
blocks.en: PAT and Industry 4.0 are driving more continuous monitoring and real-time release (RTR) applications

blocks.zh: 使用本指南時，建議對照最新版本的相關法規和藥典章節進行差異分析。
blocks.en: When using this guide, it is advisable to perform a gap analysis against the latest versions of the relevant regulations and pharmacopeial chapters.
